comment: Role-rule exceptions the role check accepts while A-004's migration is unfinished. The role rules judge every home, so an edge that used to escape judgement by sitting in an old home now needs an explicit entry here: module pair, owner, and the condition that ends the exception. Each entry names both files, so a reviewer sees the exact dependency. An entry that no longer matches a measured edge fails the check (see `roleRule`), so the list shrinks as the modules move instead of accumulating.

entries.exitCondition: The shell stops reading platform storage directly and takes it through the feature port that owns the state; the import goes with the last direct read.
Session transfer download moves behind the sessions feature's published surface; the shell calls that instead.
Team mode is read through the feature that owns it, not from the shell.
The assembly's selectors are reached through the composition root's own interface rather than imported by the shell.
Shell state stops living in the application assembly's store; the last reader moves with it.
The shell no longer constructs the application; the composition root owns construction and hands the shell what it needs.
The shared menu takes its projection as an injected contract instead of reaching into the shell's projection.
The turn substrate moves to client/features/turn/application/ and consumes interactions' published contracts.
